mapper.select: SELECT PPS.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO, TO_CHAR(PPS.PAY_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') PAY_DATE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PPS.SALARY_DISTIN_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) SALARY_DISTIN, PWF.PA_CONFIRM_FLAG FROM PA_PAY_SCHEDULE PPS, PA_WORK_FLOW PWF WHERE PPS.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PPS.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = PWF.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO AND PPS.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY PPS.PAY_DATE DESC

SELECT A.ITEM_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(A.ITEM_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ITEM_NAME FROM AR_STA_ITEM A, AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM B WHERE A.ITEM_NO = B.ITEM_NO AND B.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.MANAGE_FLAG = 1 ORDER BY B.CAL_ORDER

sql.if: AND ( HRE.EMPID LIKE '%' || #{key, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(HRE.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{key, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%' )

AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HRE.DEPTNO AND HR_DEPARTMENT.ACTIVITY = 1 START WITH HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = #{deptNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY PRIOR HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT.PARENT_DEPT_NO)

SELECT HRE.EMPID, HRE.LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(HRE.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) DEPTNAME, ASM.ITEM_NO, ASM.CAL_VALUE, ASM.FINAL_VALUE FROM AR_SUMMARY_MANAGE_HAE ASM, HR_EMPLOYEE HRE WHERE ASM.PERSON_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID AND ASM.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = #{payScheduleNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY HRE.DEPTNO, HRE.EMPID
mapper.update: UPDATE AR_SUMMARY_MANAGE_HAE SET FINAL_VALUE = #{finalValue, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, REMARK = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE AR_SUMMARY_MANAGE_NO = #{arSummaryManageNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
